offer.text: My records are out of date. Go and speak with 3 of our farmers and note who's still working the fields.

decline.text: The ledger will gather dust a while longer.

in_progress.text: How many farmers have you counted?

ready.text: Three accounted for — the census is whole again. Splendid.

complete.text: Tidy work. The archive thanks you, as do I.
